verdict.rationale: LlamaParse has a dedicated webhooks page. It says users can configure webhook endpoints to be notified immediately when jobs complete, fail, or reach other states, instead of polling. That covers the core of subscribing to events via webhooks. The evidence is one short doc excerpt, so depth is thin. Missing for 10: a documented event-type catalog and payload schema, details on signature verification and retries, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
